verses.he: שִׁ֥יר הַֽמַּעֲל֗וֹת לְדָ֫וִ֥ד לוּלֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה שֶׁהָ֣יָה לָ֑נוּ יֹֽאמַר־נָ֝א יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.en: A Song of Ascents; of David. 'If it had not been the LORD who was for us', Let Israel now say;

verses.he: לוּלֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה שֶׁהָ֣יָה לָ֑נוּ בְּק֖וּם עָלֵ֣ינוּ אָדָֽם׃
verses.en: 'If it had not been the LORD who was for us, When men rose up against us,

verses.he: אֲ֭זַי חַיִּ֣ים בְּלָע֑וּנוּ בַּחֲר֖וֹת אַפָּ֣ם בָּֽנוּ׃
verses.en: Then they had swallowed us up alive, When their wrath was kindled against us;

verses.he: אֲ֭זַי הַמַּ֣יִם שְׁטָפ֑וּנוּ נַ֝֗חְלָה עָבַ֥ר עַל־נַפְשֵֽׁנוּ׃
verses.en: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, The stream had gone over our soul;
Then the proud waters Had gone over our soul.'

verses.he: בָּר֥וּךְ יְהוָ֑ה שֶׁלֹּ֥א נְתָנָ֥נוּ טֶ֝֗רֶף לְשִׁנֵּיהֶֽם׃
verses.en: Blessed be the LORD, Wo hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.

verses.he: נַפְשֵׁ֗נוּ כְּצִפּ֥וֹר נִמְלְטָה֮ מִפַּ֪ח י֫וֹקְשִׁ֥ים הַפַּ֥ח נִשְׁבָּ֗ר וַאֲנַ֥חְנוּ נִמְלָֽטְנוּ׃
verses.en: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers; The snare is broken, and we are escaped.

verses.he: עֶ֭זְרֵנוּ בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה עֹ֝שֵׂ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: Our help is in the name of the LORD, Who made heaven and earth.
